lines: I'd fight with Figma or skip the diagram.
This tool makes editorial diagrams for Claude, Copilot, and other agents so you skip fighting with Figma.
It reads your website to grab colors and fonts, then applies them directly so every diagram matches your brand.
Paste a Mermaid chart and get self-contained HTML with editorial styling.
The repository has 45,744 stars and ships self-contained HTML.
One accent color highlights 1–2 things first, so you know exactly where to look.
You can export diagrams to SVG or PNG at any scale.
Before you try it, run one Python script to lint your skin before submitting.
Made by Cathryn Lavery. The repo uses licence files to prove trust.
Open docs/cookbook for install recipes, or run git clone to start your editable project.
Send this to someone who wastes hours in Figma instead of drawing clear diagrams.
Save time on Figma and try diagram-design.
